_comment: Issue #1411: a lone Archers regiment marches south at full sprint for several seconds (gait forced via a quadruple right-click, so it isn't just the last-200wu-before-arrival auto-sprint window) -- the same sustained-sprint shape as the production pace_modes scenario named in the issue. Demonstrates the soldiers tracking their moving formation slots at speed with no superphysical burst: worst per-soldier speed stays comfortably under move_speed * superphysical_speed_frac (103.5 wu/s at this unit's stats) the whole march.
